question: Related Questions Q. دو دن پہلے میں نے خواب دیکھا کہ ایک کمرہ میں خنزیر کے بہت سارے بچے ہیں، اور ایک بچہ میرے ہاتھ میں ہے۔ 2230 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 39742 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Please interpret my dream. In morning hours I dreamt that my little brothers were coming from school and were crossing the road Question: Please interpret my dream. In morning hours I dreamt that my little brothers were coming from school and were crossing the road. A car came and ran on them and my brothers were cut in half. I was screaming their names. I woke up and cried a lot. I am very scared. Answer ID: 39742 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1023/615/L=1433) You need not worry. In-shaAllah, your condition shall turn better. You should keep fast, offer salah, do zikr, recitation and dua extensively. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
